calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Sep-10-2019 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of an Adult and a Minor.
Dept. 514. Judge: Gail Dekreon. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioners Sokunthea Keo and Cody Sandgren Skaggs were present in pro per.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an adult from Sokunthea Keo to Sokunthea Keo Sandrgen.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor from Juniper Soriya Skaggs Keo to Juniper Soriya Sandgren.

Decrees Changing Names were submitted to and signed by the Court.
